name: Kawung
summary: Indonesian business and investment legal research with cited regulations, officially free, with published daily and weekly usage caps.
description: Kawung (kawung.id) is a legal-research tool for Indonesian business and investment law: you ask a question and get an explanation with article citations, or you search and read curated regulations (updated weekly, including selected regional rules). Official usage page (Batas pemakaian): it is free (gratis). Each visitor has daily and weekly allowances so everyone can use it — quick research 5/day and 30/week, in-depth research 5/day and 30/week, regulation search 100/day, documents opened 50/day, browse/tool pages 600/day. Daily caps reset at 00:00 WIB; weekly caps reset each Monday at 00:00 WIB. No paid plan is listed on the official pages checked. The interface is available in Indonesian and English.

pricing.details: Officially free, with published daily and weekly caps (for example 5 quick and 5 in-depth researches per day). No paid plan is listed on the official pages checked.
